text:
Sophie H: Heads up — after last night's kernel selector roll, our deploy-time prefill hit-rate for the KV prefix cache dropped from ~83% -> ~54% on prod-dedicated pools. Noticing higher tail latencies too. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

Jamal K: saw the alert this morning. spikes coincided with autoscaler churn at 03:40 UTC. curious if the kernel change affected tokenization or key canonicalization.

Nisha R: quick check: the kernel switch only touched attention kernels and memory layout, shouldn't affect tokenizer. but we did flip to `runtime-v2` path that uses a different input canonicalizer before creating KV keys. possible desync between prefill jobs and live path.

Liam P: autoscale churn + cache cold starts amplify hit-rate drop. if prefillers were using old canonicalization, keys won't match. can we confirm what the prefill job binary used?

Sophie H: prefill job in deploy pipeline is still pinned to `prefill-worker:2026-02-18` (old canonicalizer). deploys after kernel switch used runtime-v2=live. so mismatch seems likely.

Jamal K: replicated locally: run a short script generating KV keys for same prefix under both canonicalizers -> produced different hashes for ~22% of prefixes (mostly punctuation/whitespace normalization differences).

Nisha R: that 22% maps closely to the observed hit-rate delta. Looks like input canonicalization drifted. Fix strategy: 1) unify canonicalizer into upstream API layer used by both prefillers and live runtime; 2) short-term: re-run prefill with the runtime-v2 canonicalizer; 3) add a canary measuring prefix key overlap before rolling.

Sophie H: agree. Short term mitigation I'd like to try: scheduled synthetic prefill job that uses runtime-v2 canonicalizer, run as a ramp for 1h across affected pools. Also add a quick shim to prefillers to log canonicalizer version in the job metadata.

Liam P: for the autoscale angle, we should also look at batching heuristics. kernel change reduced per-token throughput, so autoscaler scaled up slower -> more cold starts. can we temporarily increase `min_ready_replicas` for ded pool until we stabilize?

Jamal K: runbook note — raising `min_ready_replicas` by 1 increased cost but reduced cold starts in prior incidents. quick command to patch:

```
# k8s patch to bump min ready
kubectl -n redwood patch deployment prefill-worker --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/min_ready_replicas","value":"2"}]'
```

Nisha R: I'll put up a tiny change to prefill workflow so it imports canonicalizer v2 as a library instead of the old binary. Then we can re-run prefill in CI and in prod as scheduled job.

perf-ci: perf-ci detected regression: prefill hit-rate reduced by 29 percentage points after `kernel-select-2026-03` in canary. Linking trace: https://ci.redwood.internal/trace/abc123 :rotating_light:

Sophie H: thanks. Action plan: (A) patch prefill workflow to use canonicalizer v2 (Nisha) (B) schedule synthetic prefill ramp across pools for 1 hour starting +15m (Sophie) (C) bump min_ready_replicas on affected pools (Liam) (D) add canonicalizer version tag to prefill metadata & add unit test for key parity (Jamal).

Liam P: I'll schedule the min_ready change and watch cost impact. also will add a dashboard panel that shows `prefill_key_overlap_ratio` computed from sampling.

Jamal K: small smoke test I ran to exercise the prefill endpoint (useful to rerun in prod canary):

```
for p in $(cat top-prefixes.txt); do
  curl -X POST https://prefill.internal/v1/seed -d "{\"prefix\": \"$p\", \"canonicalizer_version\": \"v2\"}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREFILL_TOKEN"
  sleep 0.02
done
```

Nisha R: I'll open a PR to convert the prefill binary to the shared canonicalizer and add a parity test comparing 10k sampled prefixes across both implementations. will tag it `prefill/canonicalizer-v2`.

Sophie H: timeline — if we can deploy the prefill change and run the synthetic ramp within 3 hours, we should recover most of the hit-rate before next business-hour spike.

deploy-bot: deploy prefill-worker/2026-03-18 -> runtime-v2-canonicalizer scheduled for 3412345690 by Nisha R

Jamal K: post-deploy smoke shows overlap ratio up to 91% after re-prefill run. tail latency dropped ~18% in the 99th. I'll push numbers to the perf dashboard. :rocket:

Sophie H: excellent. follow-ups: - add canonicalizer version to telemetry (important) - add pre-deploy parity check into CI (blocker) - schedule periodic synthetic prefill job for new kernel rollouts

Liam P: will do the dashboard panels and propagate an ops note for oncall. leaving a small reminder to revert min_ready_replicas after 12h if cost impact unacceptable.

Sophie H: thanks team. closing the thread; will post a short incident summary in #incidents after numbers stabilize. :thumbsup:
